personality_one_liner: A high-stakes tactical command center merging sports-management density with cyber-investigation tension.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use only if absolutely necessary for overlay menus, but prefer solid surfaceSecondary with border for command-center feel
dont's: Do not use blur for cards or lists; clarity and data density are paramount in Dark-First Utility

screens.name: Intro
screens.purpose: Role selection (THE HACKER / THE HUNTER) to set the narrative context.
screens.layout: Full-screen cinematic split or two massive cards. Use the satellite view image as background with a heavy gradient-to-dark scrim. Typography should be oversized, high-contrast, utilizing the display font to create an immediate hacker/investigation mood.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Primary command center showing player stats, AP, and current targets.

states.empty: No active targets. Display placeholder outline.

screens.layout: Modular widget-based architecture. Top row: Player stats (Money, Stress, Skill, Heat, Reputation) in dense, pixel-perfect metric cards. Middle section: Turn-based timeline (Day/AP). Bottom section: List of 3 fictional targets in a table-like format with visual severity indicators. Use tabular numerals for stats.

screens.name: Operation
screens.purpose: Abstract 5-phase tactical execution (Recon to Escape) with decision cards.
screens.layout: Hierarchical tactical view. Top: 5-Phase progress bar (Recon -> Access -> Persistence -> Extraction -> Escape) acting as the main anchor. Center: Current phase details (Time, Costs, Risks) in monospace-like structured blocks. Bottom: Horizontal scroll or grid of Decision Cards (cautious, fast, etc.). Use helper labels and avoid generic descriptions.

screens.name: Banking
screens.purpose: High-end fintech interface managing legal vs illegal funds, fixed costs, and data assets.
screens.layout: Mobile-first single-column fintech approach. Generous horizontal padding. Top: Large tabular balance with 'available' vs 'marked'. Middle: Action chips for 'Jobs' and 'Data Ownership' (Sell/Publish/Delete). Bottom: Transaction history with animated row insertions. Use ghost borders/background shifts instead of heavy lines. DO NOT rely only on color for income/expense; use +/-, alignment, and icons.

screens.name: NewsFeed
screens.purpose: Chronological stream of world events and consequences of player actions.
screens.layout: Timeline layout with vertical connector line. Each news item is a card. Distinguish between global news and direct consequences using visual tags (brandTertiary for player-related, surfaceTertiary for world).

hero_intro_bg.alt: Satellite view of dark city at night

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow 'Dark-First Utility DARK' layout principles: command-center aesthetic, modular widgets, and pixel-based density.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000) for backgrounds to prevent eye strain; stick to the provided #0E0E12 base.
Banking Screen MUST use semantic formatting for numbers (tabular numerals) and not rely exclusively on green/red colors for positive/negative balances. Use +/- signs and icons for accessibility.
All interactive decision cards in the Operation screen must feel tactical. Use sharp edges (radius 'sm' or 'md') and subtle border changes for focus states.
Ensure 'reduced motion' requirement from the brief is respected. Animations (like new transactions) should be subtle opacities/slides, not exaggerated bounces.
Use a vertical gradient-to-dark scrim underneath all text placed on background images (Intro, Banking top header if using image).
Never use Indigo, Violet, or Blue. Adhere strictly to the Amber/Obsidian palette.
